Posting quick findings from the host diagnostics (attached: redwood-run-heap-prof.tar.gz):
- Variant-b hosts experienced periodic GC stalls and increased resident set; we saw 2 instances with repeated allocation failures and one instance restarted by the host manager.
- Kernel selection log shows quant-kernel fallback on longer sequences which triggered slower kernels for >1.2k token requests. RushCreek’s capture had several long prompt sessions.
- KV cache hit-rate dropped slightly due to variant config mismatch — TTL settings differ between variants.

Mitigation attempted: dropped canary weight to 1% at 21:02 UTC and warmed additional warm pools. Latencies improved but p99 still above baseline. I recommend full rollback and then re-run with a controlled, very small proportion while we patch the quant-kernel path and align cache TTLs.

— Rachel
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
